scope: new live provider run in this release
reasons: The new historical indistinguishability witness is verified offline, not a model efficacy claim.
Request-scoped receipt evidence adds a trusted permission requiring matched access and unique-id persistence constraints.
The frozen legacy live action allowlist does not include receipt_lookup; an additive versioned parser/execution pilot has not been built or accepted.
empirical_question_for_next_protocol: With the same correct final report, can a model select request-scoped historical evidence and distinguish supported safe stop from confirmed historical-violation escalation under aligned responsibility definitions?
strong_baseline: A fixed receipt_lookup followed by public numeric/history checks already resolves all four witness snapshots; any future strategy must have identical evidence permissions and budgets.
not_the_sole_reason: Independent review pending is not the sole reason for no-go.
reopen_conditions: Implement an additive versioned live action parser/runner admitting receipt_lookup without changing frozen old tools.
Verify same-permission strong baseline, matched observations/budgets, errors and no private-oracle leakage.
Freeze paired conditions, measured decisions, stopping rules and minimum request/token caps before a new live call.
